prompt: Build a SaaS landing page for Atlas AI Consulting

2. Configure the theme with navy and electric-blue palette and Inter font.
3. Add a hero section with a compelling headline and CTA.

6. Add a logos section for social proof.
7. Add a three-tier pricing section (Starter, Growth, Enterprise).
8. Add a testimonials section with three quotes.
9. Add a closing contact section with a CTA to book a discovery call.
personaMessage: Your Atlas AI Consulting landing page is built out! Hero, features, pricing, testimonials, and contact section are all set.

props.text: Harness the power of artificial intelligence to drive innovation, efficiency, and growth.

props.alt: An introductory video about Atlas AI Consulting services

props.title: AI Strategy & Vision
props.hook: Unsure where AI fits into your business? We'll chart the course.
props.problem: Many businesses recognize AI's potential but lack a clear roadmap to integrate it effectively, leading to fragmented efforts and missed opportunities.
props.resolution: Atlas AI Consulting provides comprehensive strategic planning, identifying high-impact AI use cases tailored to your business goals and competitive landscape, ensuring a clear path to innovation.

props.title: AI Implementation & Development
props.hook: From concept to code, we build robust AI solutions that deliver.
props.problem: Developing and deploying AI models can be complex, requiring specialized technical expertise and careful integration into existing systems, often overwhelming internal teams.
props.resolution: Our expert engineers handle the full lifecycle of AI development, from model design and training to deployment and maintenance, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance.

props.title: AI Training & Empowerment
props.hook: Empower your team to confidently manage and scale your AI initiatives.
props.problem: Without proper training, teams struggle to adopt new AI tools and processes, limiting the potential ROI of AI investments and fostering resistance to change.
props.resolution: We offer customized training programs and workshops designed to upskill your workforce, ensuring your team is proficient in managing, optimizing, and leveraging AI technologies effectively.

content.heading: Our Expertise: Your AI Journey Partner
content.subheading: From strategic planning to practical implementation and team empowerment, we cover every step.

content.heading: Flexible AI Solutions for Every Business
content.subheading: Choose the plan that best fits your AI ambitions and business scale.

props.author: Marcus Chen
